scope: Approved coordination-model inventory for only A11/as-3 members 354, 355, 318, 322, 352 and 351. This is not a fabrication or as-built model.

change_visualisation.meaning: Display-only identification of this development change set. It does not describe steel paint, coating, material, construction status or source confidence.

IPE500.representation: Nominal rolled IPE profile with idealised profile geometry for coordination; rolling tolerances, camber and connection-specific modifications are excluded.

HEA200.representation: Nominal rolled HEA profile with idealised profile geometry for coordination; rolling tolerances, camber and connection-specific modifications are excluded.

centreline_definitions_mm.method: Derived from the calibrated Section_A11_Axis_3 source projection: outer-column midpoint pairs, HEA200 outer contour midpoint pairs, and paired long roof contour edges. The drawing traces determine member axes; text location is not used as geometry.
centreline_definitions_mm.section_orientation: A11/as-3 is a YZ elevation at the exact axis-3 station X=59100 mm. IPE500 and HEA200 profile section height h is in the elevation plane; flange width b is out of plane along X. The observed raised-ridge separation between the two IPE500 rafter centerlines is preserved.

A11_03_354.derivation: Midpoints of A-side outer IPE500 column contour edges in paths 1185/1186. Literal label 354 IPE500-S355JR is visually adjacent in AANZICHT as-3.

A11_03_355.derivation: Midpoints of E-side outer IPE500 column contour edges in paths 1187/1188. Literal label 355 IPE500-S355JR is visually adjacent in AANZICHT as-3.

A11_03_318.derivation: Midpoints of B-side HEA200 outer contour edges in paths 1189/1190. Literal label 318 HEA200 is visually adjacent in AANZICHT as-3.

A11_03_322.derivation: Midpoints of C-side HEA200 outer contour edges in paths 1191/1192. Literal label 322 HEA200 is visually adjacent in AANZICHT as-3.

A11_03_352.derivation: Midpoints of paired A-side IPE500 roof contour edges in path 1210. Literal label 352 IPE500-S355JR is visually adjacent in AANZICHT as-3.

A11_03_351.derivation: Midpoints of paired E-side IPE500 roof contour edges in paths 1211/1212. The source-projected raised-ridge gap is preserved. Literal label 351 IPE500-S355JR is visually adjacent in AANZICHT as-3.

explicitly_not_inferred: No K200*100*4 member 372, connection, base plate, stiffener, secondary steel, mirrored member or unlabelled source contour is included.
No fabrication definition or as-built claim is made.
